correctness.rationale: For each n>=3, at most one equality test per vertex; proper partial three-colourings of a proper cycle vertex subset extend across all gaps. All-positive and 101 traces force alternating target colours on consecutive triples; 1001 excludes four-run supports. A complete 8-trace table proves permitted triple runs, with one/two-run tables similarly explicit. Exact n/r rooting with positive gap compositions proves each coefficient. The direct-trace verifier exhaustively checks all 4^n marked supports for 3<=n<=8 against independent formula. The n=3 full-cycle exception is handled by 6<8 proper colourings. Checks support, not replace, universal proof. The nonpurity corollary constructs all maximal alternating-position supports via proper target colourings of an auxiliary cycle and checks one-step nonextendability.

value.rationale: Counting every binary vertex-colour test support for the standard three-colouring concept class of cycles is a natural face-enumeration refinement beyond the already-known scalar VC dimension. The complete local run/multiplicity classification and exact coefficientwise formula distinguish selected-vertex support patterns, expose the alternating triple constraint and recover the full finite-size profile at arbitrary cycle orders. It is a structural all-order theorem with direct reproducible checks, not an arbitrary finite numerical slice or a restatement of the rank. In even cycles the same structural law proves infinitely many nonpure complexes and enumerates an exact family of lower-dimensional maximal faces.
